rationale: Codex's plan is the only one complete against the owner's design comment, covering proposal visibility and binding in review inputs, the authorized-lineage carry-forward, publication-gated serialized adoption, baseline-evidence activation that handles new scripts in existing manifests, and the existing install tests; the muse plan omits required behavior and mine has the review-binding, activation and persistence gaps identified in all three reviews, while codex's remaining points (candidate checks non-empty, PR-body formatter, schema-move importers) are small corrections.
